description: 工業廢棄物供需資訊 [waste management] is a dataset listed in Government Open Data Platform of Taiwan (data.gov.tw), an open data portal, published or maintained by 經濟部產業發展署. 提供各類廢棄物供需數量及頻率等資訊予事業機構產生者及需求者參考及選擇，以推動事業廢棄物交換再利用之機制。. Coverage: Taiwan. The portal files it under the publisher 經濟部產業發展署. Its tags are 公共資訊. It offers 1 resource(s) in csv. The portal shows 2024-09-23 as the last metadata change. The title and description are in Chinese; the topic words in square brackets are the cataloguer's translation of the title. It is reached through the links recorded on this page, with the catalogue entry as the discovery route. Access is free of charge and open. The licence is 政府資料開放授權條款-第1版. Caveats: this record was written from the catalogue listing only, so the linked page was not opened, its contents and current availability were not checked, and the description may lag the source. Suitability for infrastructure simulation has not been checked. Related record: the catalogue-level record data-tw-dgt-portal.
